title: Smithy flow document
description: Versioned contract for the smithy flow file format (v2). Compatibility rules: adding optional fields does NOT bump the version; removing/renaming fields or changing semantics requires v3 plus a migration path. Readers must reject unknown versions with an explicit error.

breakpoints.description: Optional. Node ids with breakpoints (designer/debug session hint).

kind.description: start: entry point (one per flow). end: terminator. if: decision (condition). loop: foreach/while. set: create/overwrite a variable. tool: execute a registered tool (requires 'tool').

tool.description: Registered tool name (e.g. 'windows.click'). Required when kind == 'tool'.

config.description: Tool arguments or node parameters. For tool nodes: validated against the tool schema. Selector fields are flat: name, automation_id, control_type, class_name, pid (drag uses from_*/to_* prefixes). For set nodes: {var, type: auto|string|number|bool|json, value}.

label.description: Optional human-readable annotation shown on the block.

save_as.description: Optional. Store the tool result into this variable.

source.description: Id of the source node (must exist in nodes).

source_handle.description: Output handle on the source node. Allowed values: start/tool/set → 'out'; if → 'true' | 'false' | 'error'; loop → 'body' | 'done' | 'error'. 'error' edges are the error-handling path.

target.description: Id of the target node (must exist in nodes).
